title: Chapter 227 Balance Of Situation
content:
Chapter 227 Balance Of Situation

Nodding his head with deep comprehension, Zhong Yuyi felt very satisfied that King Yan followed his words, and finally led him to his own train of thought, so the next step is the real topic!

"Yes, Qin is our number one threat now. If he succeeds and defeats us, then the entire alliance will be in danger of destroying the country, let alone anything else!" The emphasis is on the threat of Qin.

"However, Qin State still has hundreds of thousands of troops, which poses a great threat to us. It is still a difficult problem to defeat this powerful military force!" King Yan also nodded approvingly. Everyone understands the threat of Qin State, but he is more afraid of Qin State's strength than anyone else.

"That's why we need more warriors to support the great cause of fighting against Qin. Brave men like Big Iron Hammer have made great achievements. We must reward them heavily and set an example. Let everyone in the world know that for us The great Qin State has made great contributions, and our coalition forces will not hesitate to reward them, so that all the heroes in the world will be used by us, and will fight to the death for the great cause of Qin!" After some generous speeches, Zhong Yu finally spoke his mind after speaking for so long intention.

King Yan raised his eyebrows. From what he just said, he suddenly came back to his senses. The person in front of him said so much, and he just wanted to reward the big hammer. He just said so much in a roundabout way because he was afraid that he would not agree. .

It's just that what he just said is indeed reasonable. Qin State is a threat, and Qi State is also a threat. If these two threats are not removed, King Yan will feel uneasy when he sleeps.

Moreover, rewarding the big iron hammer is not a big hindrance to his country of Yan, but it is of great benefit, which can stimulate the morale of the soldiers under his country of Yan.

"What your highness said is also reasonable, so how about it, according to your highness's suggestion just now, promote the big iron hammer to be the general of ten thousand people in my country of Yan, and be in charge of ten thousand people!" Taking a deep breath, King Yan slowly relieved To relieve his tense mind, he agreed to the appointment of Big Hammer.

The singing and dancing below continued, and the generals toasted and enjoyed the rare prosperity of this moment.

These generals basically didn't notice that the two kings above them had talked about a major issue concerning the fate of the world in this short period of time.

Maybe some people noticed it, but they didn't pay too much attention to it, they just thought it was two high-ranking people talking to each other.

As the high and powerful people in a country, there are always certain questions that need to be discussed alone. As generals under them, they shouldn't ask too many questions at all, they just need to obey.

But now that their conversation was over, they turned their heads, gathered their gazes below, glanced around, and finally stared closely at the sledgehammer that was drinking with its head raised.

The big iron hammer, who was drinking, suddenly stopped his movement of drinking. As a powerhouse of the fourth rank, he felt very keenly that someone was staring at him, and it came from above him, that is, his king. Location.

Turning his head to look over, he found that King Jing and his own King Yan were staring at him closely without distraction, which made him tense, thinking that he had made some rude moves by mistake, which attracted the attention of the two. people are angry.

But before he stood up and apologized, King Yan in front of him spoke in advance.

King Yan coughed, making the generals who had noticed that something was wrong with the atmosphere in the big tent, slowly stopped their heroic actions, completely calmed down, and listened to his words quietly.

"Big Iron Hammer, just now I had a conversation with His Highness Prince Jing, and I think it's an extraordinary time, and it's time to employ people, and the effectiveness of a brave man like you is very much needed in order to defeat Qin and restore the world to a bright future. !" King Yan first said a big truth, which is also the problem of the superiors, saying that they always have to make some truths before, to show the righteousness, and at the same time let the subordinates understand who is their master.

None of the generals made a sound, even if King Yan paused for a while, they still sat in their positions without any movement, and even the sound of their slight breathing became much quieter.

Because they know that next, the main show is coming!

"So, after discussing it with King Jing, I think it's not enough to just reward some wine and meat for your military exploits. You must make some promotions to let the world understand that our coalition forces are clearly rewarded and punished, and that we value talents!" As he said that, King Yan paused again, whetting the appetites of everyone below.

After the generals below heard it, they did not exceed King Yan's expectations. Some people's breathing became heavy, and the big hammer was also a little surprised. Although he didn't care for fame and wealth, he was also somewhat interested in being able to be promoted. .

In the anticipation of everyone's appetite, King Yan continued: "So, we have made a decision to promote the big hammer from a thousand generals to a ten thousand general. Big hammer, I hope you will not disappoint our appointment today. , continue to lead the soldiers of our country of Yan, slash the generals and draw the flag on the battlefield, invincible!"

After Big Iron Hammer heard the reward from King Yan, he couldn't help showing excitement on his face. Afterwards, he turned serious, restrained all his expressions, and said solemnly:

"I will not dare to betray the king's heart. After the big iron hammer takes over, he will definitely slay the generals and capture the flag on the battlefield, raise the prestige of our country of Yan, and strengthen the momentum of our coalition forces!"

"Okay, can you think so? This king is very happy. I will send the tiger seal letter to your account in a while. You can go and see your new subordinate tomorrow. I want you to use the shortest time to gather the morale of the army. Lead them into a brave army, and show off their style in the next decisive battle with the Qin army and defeat the Qin army!" King Yan nodded in satisfaction, feeling very relieved about the big hammer's statement.

In fact, for King Yan, the addition of a powerful general like Big Iron Hammer is not all a bad thing. The entire court is controlled by Yan Chunjun and Yan Yi, which is very detrimental to the stability of the kingship for him.

However, the Prince Pill he cultivated lost its prestige in Yan after the battle of Jidu.

Therefore, the promotion of the big iron hammer at this time can strengthen the army of Yan State and balance the situation in the court.

He heard that Big Iron Hammer and Crown Prince Dan of Yan were very close, and they belonged to the princeling faction. Promoting him at this time would definitely rebalance the situation between the two factions.

And Yan Wang, at this time, can also take advantage of the situation, manipulate the situation, and continue his status as a high-ranking arbitrator.
